summary: @Seven, stylised as At Seven, was a New Zealand comedy show in which Petra Bagust and other comedians presented the "real news" from the previous 24 hours in New Zealand and worldwide. It filled the timeslot of the current-affairs program Campbell Live during the 2009/2010 Summer Holidays while Campbell Live was on break. The show finished on 22 January 2010, Campbell Live returned to its normal 7pm slot, and @Seven did not come back the following summer, when TV3 screened re-runs of Modern Family instead.
one_line: @Seven was a New Zealand comedy news show hosted by Petra Bagust that filled in for Campbell Live during the 2009/2010 summer break.
key_facts: @Seven was a New Zealand comedy show, commonly stylised as @Seven.
Petra Bagust and other comedians presented the "real news" from the last 24 hours from New Zealand and the rest of the world on @Seven.
@Seven replaced Campbell Live, a New Zealand current-affairs program, for the Summer Holidays in 2009/2010 while Campbell Live took a break.
@Seven finished for the 2009/2010 summer holiday break on 22 January 2010.
On 22 January 2010, @Seven was replaced with the normal TV3 7pm show, Campbell Live.
@Seven did not return the following summer break.
Instead of @Seven, TV3 screened re-runs of Modern Family the following summer break.
